subject: MedSecure — POC orchestration: rotating hands-on windows & load-plan
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@medsecure.co>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
Cc: tom.nguyen@medsecure.co
Date: 2027-03-29T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC kickoff — coordinate US/EU/APAC hands-on windows

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We'd like to lock in a POC kickoff with hands-on sessions (prompt review, routing config, and a short load test) across our operations teams in CA, Berlin and Singapore. Ideally we'd run two 90-minute hands-on windows (one for Americas/EMEA overlap and one for APAC-friendly).

Constraints:
- Our SREs (Tom) prefer early mornings PST for load tests.
- Product leads in Berlin are only available 0900–1300 CET.
- APAC folks can be online 1000–1600 SGT but prefer late-morning SGT.

Can you propose a rotating set of windows and a plan for shared prep (prompts + routing configs) + a short load rehearsal? We want to ensure minimal disruption to production while exercising our fallback routing.

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Director, Platform Engineering
MedSecure, Inc.
From: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@medsecure.co>
Cc: tom.nguyen@medsecure.co, aditya.rao@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-03-30T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — coordinate US/EU/APAC hands-on windows

Hi Elena —

Thanks — this is exactly the kind of info we want. Quick proposal below for two rotating windows + a prep checklist. If that looks good we can drop invites and attach a short load-test plan for review.

Proposed windows (each 90 min):
1) Americas/EMEA overlap (rotate weekly): 11:00–12:30 PDT / 19:00–20:30 CET — hands-on + prompt walk-through
2) APAC-focused (rotate weekly): 23:00–00:30 PDT / 10:00–11:30 SGT — hands-on + short load rehearsal at the end

Notes:
- We recommend a 30-minute prep doc-share (prompts, example routing rules, expected traffic profile) 24 hrs before each session.
- For load test: a 10-minute ramp, 5-minute sustained window, 10-minute cooldown (we'll run on a shadow pool with configurable autoscale).
- Tech leads: please confirm who will own the fallback validation scripts (we can share ours).

Next steps:
- Tell me which local times look feasible for Berlin and Singapore this week, and whether you prefer the APAC session earlier (08:00 SGT) or later (11:30 SGT).
- I'll draft invites and attach the load-plan for signoff.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

I'll loop in our CI engineer if we need any specific headers/keys for traffic tagging. Otherwise go ahead and send invites.
